description.zh: 创建文档解析任务时返回的任务ID（DtsJobId）。
description.en: The task ID (DtsJobId) returned when the document parsing task was created.

description.zh: 任务所属的地域ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the task. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.zh: 查询文档解析任务的状态
title.en: Query the status of a document parsing task

descriptions.zh:
此接口对调用次数有限制，超过限制后的调用会被拒绝。
- 单个地域累计允许调用的阈值为200 次/秒。
- 单个地域允许单个账号调用的阈值为20 次/秒。
descriptions.en:
This operation has call frequency limits. Calls that exceed the limits are rejected.
- The cumulative call threshold for a single region is 200 calls per second.
- The call threshold for a single account in a single region is 20 calls per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-doc-parser-job-status --dts-job-id dts-20250729-l3m1213ye7l0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --rag-instance-id example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
